text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep ya waiting! It's the great 
Gold Ship-sama!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I'll let you help me with my ambition! 
Let's sail the seven seas and find the 
eighth!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"First, we gotta clear some quests! Look 
up the walkthrough wikis and find out 
which races drop the ship materials!"

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
